title: Closed-fibre differential extension of a parameter-vanishing defect
statement: Let $R\to T$ be a local homomorphism of commutative local rings, with $T$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and write $\mathfrak m_R,\mathfrak m_T$ for their unique maximal ideals. Let $t$ be a finite list generating $\mathfrak m_R$, $L=\mathfrak m_RT$, and assume $T/L$ is formally smooth over $R/\mathfrak m_R$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_T$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let $D$ be a commutative $R$-algebra, $J^2=0$, $g:T\to D/J$ an $R$-algebra map, and $f:T\to D$ a ring lift [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Assume $f$ agrees with the base map on $t$ and every representative of $g(x)$ for $x\in\mathfrak m_T$ annihilates $J$. Then there exists an additive map $\delta:T\to D$ with $\delta(1)=0$, $\delta(T)\subset J$, $\delta(xz)=f(x)\delta(z)+f(z)\delta(x)$, and $\delta(r_T)=f(r_T)-r_D$ for all $r\in R$. This is extension of a derivation [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], not construction of an algebra lift.

proof.text: The difference f composed with R -> T minus the structure map to D is an integer derivation into J, since both maps coincide modulo J and J has square zero. It vanishes on t. The T-action through f makes J a vector space over K=T/m_T; locality makes its R-action factor through k=R/m_R.

The universal property gives a differential functional on Omega_(R/Z). It kills m_R Omega_(R/Z), and the differentials of the generators t generate the conormal image for m_R. The quotient differential exact sequence therefore factors it through Omega_(k/Z). Tensor this functional with K.

The closed fibre C=T/L is a Noetherian local k-algebra with residue field canonically K. Its formal smoothness makes the base-field differential map after tensoring with K injective. Extend the functional along this injection by a vector-space basis, and precompose with d:T -> Omega_(C/Z) -> K tensor_C Omega_(C/Z). The resulting derivation has the required restriction, values in J, and Leibniz law for the f-action.

theorem exists_closedFiber_defect_derivation
    (R : Type u) (T : Type v) [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing T] [IsNoetherianRing T]
    [Algebra R T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R T)]
    (t : List R) (ht : Ideal.span {r | r ∈ t} = maximalIdeal R) :
    let L : Ideal T := (maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R T)
    letI : Algebra (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap (Ideal.le_comap_map :
        maximalIdeal R ≤ L.comap (algebraMap R T))
    FormallySmoothAdic (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L)
        ((maximalIdeal T).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk L)) →
    ∀ (D : Type w) [CommRing D] [Algebra R D] (J : Ideal D), J ^ 2 = ⊥ →
      ∀ (g : T →ₐ[R] D ⧸ J) (f : T →+* D),
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp f = g.toRingHom →
      (∀ r ∈ t, f (algebraMap R T r) = algebraMap R D r) →
      (∀ x ∈ maximalIdeal T, ∀ d : D, Ideal.Quotient.mk J d = g x →
        ∀ j ∈ J, d * j = 0) →
      ∃ δ : T →+ D, δ 1 = 0 ∧ (∀ x, δ x ∈ J) ∧
        (∀ x z, δ (x * z) = f x * δ z + f z * δ x) ∧
        ∀ r : R, δ (algebraMap R T r) =
          f (algebraMap R T r) - algebraMap R D r
